newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-BETIS COACH SAVED BY LATE-NIGHT REPRIEVE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BETIS COACH SAVED BY LATE-NIGHT REPRIEVE.

text.p: Real Betis will end the season with coach Lorenzo Serra Ferrer still in harness after club owner Manuel Ruiz de Lopera revoked a decision to fire him in the early hours of Friday morning.
On Thursday the coach had failed to respond to an ultimatum to sign an agreement not to move to Barcelona.
Barcelona are Betis's opponents in the Spanish Cup final on June 28.
However Serra Ferrer will leave the club on June 30th.
The conflict between the two men began with a rumour suggesting Serra Ferrer would leave Betis and take over Barcelona's reserve teams.
The Catalan side still seems the most likely destination of Serra Ferrer.
In less than four seasons in charge Serra Ferrer has taken Betis out of the second division and into European competitions on two occasions.
The most likely candiate to take over at Betis next season is Luis Aragones.
The veteran coach resigned earlier this season from Valencia, and was formerly at Sevilla, Betis's arch-rivals.
